issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

incrementalWriteEnabled.description: If set, enables incremental write of normalized data. Default for for high freq data

incrementalReadDisabled.description: If set, disables incremental read for high frequency normalized data

maxLockAttempts.description: Maximum number of attempts to make to acquire lock before giving up

maxNormalizationAttemptsOnRead.description:
Maximum number of attempts to make to normalize time series when reading normalized data
(and if the series is not previously normalized). Typically used in On Demand mode
In on demand mode, an attempt will be made to normalize the series once unless this property is set and then that state will be returned
This is important since for continuous streaming data we can be in a mode where the series is always invalidated
causing a lot of compute to be wasted.

compactInvRangesProbability.description:
Probability with which updates on invalidation ranges should be compacted during timeseries data upsert / remove
This will take care of merging the the various columns into a single column at the time.
double values in between 0 and 100 are permitted

maxNormalizedPoints.description: Max limit on the number of normalized points (4 * 24 * 365 * 20) = 700800 (20 years of 15 minute interval data)

maxIncrementalNormMonths.description:
Max number of months to consider for doing incremental normalization, if invalidation period is larger than this
threshold then trigger full normalization

mode.description: Mode using which data will be normalized

ntsShardSpec.description: Shard Nts table per the given spec

partitionStrategy.description:
Per timeseries datapoint type configuration for determining how normalized data should be partitioned in hot/cold storage
Format: <[Timeseries/Timed]DataPointType, NormalizationPartitionStrategy>
If key is ALL, then NormalizationPartitionStrategy will be applied to all types
